user_decision: Complete external official-first search and its combined proof first, then repair internal retrieval query compilation and evaluate downstream BGE and reranking without changing product version or skipping candidate-ceiling gates.

shared_query_facet_contract.purpose: Compile one evidence intent into route-specific physical queries without allowing any provider, model, retriever, embedder or reranker to reinterpret financial identity, period or relationship direction.

authority_split.deterministic_compiler: owns identity period relationship source-role filters forbidden expansions budgets and final physical query envelope
authority_split.model_optional_atoms: currently rejected for this contract after one exact-once natural plan-binding failure; any future reconsideration requires a new capability decision rather than a field patch
authority_split.provider_or_retriever: executes the compiled request and returns candidates only
authority_split.bge_and_reranker: may order an admitted candidate pool but cannot create missing candidates or promote Evidence

execution_sequence.acceptance: 60 intents route to 36 official and 24 Firecrawl shadow assignments; 12/12 required slots receive route opportunity; immutable replay preserves 5/6 Firecrawl recall, 0/6 Tencent recall, local authority and typed gaps.
Two clean archives and fresh processes reproduce route plan, immutable input hashes, SearchQualityCard and mutations with no private raw-capture dependency.
Exact lexical semantic graph negative and filtered query families compile from the same typed evidence intent with no Gold URL or cross-case leakage.

Raw/local frozen AB passed. One natural DeepSeek batch returned 18 shaped atoms but one unknown Evidence Slot, so the whole model-assisted variant was rejected with zero salvage and zero retry; deterministic local remains the baseline.
Capture-first exact-once local-only combined run; all required external targets receive a real opportunity; no reranker rescue; local date and Evidence Gate remain authoritative.
Each route consumes its own compiled query and typed filters rather than one raw user string; DELL MU NVDA qrels include entity period relationship and hard negatives.
Human-reviewed qrels and mutation cases prove target-in-pool, currentness, source authority, cross-case rejection and route contribution before any downstream ranking claim.

Compare exact and lexical baseline, dense/BGE, RRF or equivalent fusion, and reranker variants on the same admitted pool; report Recall@K, MRR/NDCG, false promotion, per-slot and per-case quality, stability, latency and resource cost.
Selected candidates pass Evidence Gate and are visibly used by Claims, Workpaper and report; retrieval metrics alone do not close product quality.
